Interface ApplicableActions

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameManager, RestoredGameManager
public interface ApplicableActions
Exposes the three player-driven actions that the GameManager can receive during a match.

Implemented by GameManager and used by the Controller as its sole entry point into the game logic, keeping the controller decoupled from the full GameManager logic.

  • Method Details

    • onMoveRequested

      void onMoveRequested(String nick, int tilePos) throws OccupiedTileException, InvalidPhaseException, InvalidPlayerException, InvalidMoveException
      Called when a player requests to place their pawn on a board tile.
      Parameters:
      nick - the nickname of the player making the move
      tilePos - the position of the tile the player wants to move to
      Throws:
      OccupiedTileException - if the target tile is already occupied
      InvalidPhaseException - if the game is not in the correct phase
      InvalidPlayerException - if the player making the move is not the current player
      InvalidMoveException - if the move is not valid for the current state

    • onDrawCardRequested

      void onDrawCardRequested(String nick, int cardId) throws InvalidPhaseException, InvalidPlayerException, InvalidDrawException
      Called when a player requests to draw a specific card.
      Parameters:
      nick - the nickname of the player requesting the draw
      cardId - the identifier of the card the player wants to draw
      Throws:
      InvalidPhaseException - if the game is not in the correct phase
      InvalidPlayerException - if the player making the draw is not the current player
      InvalidDrawException - if the card cannot be drawn

    • onSkipRequested

      void onSkipRequested(String nick) throws InvalidPhaseException, InvalidPlayerException, InvalidSkipException
      Called when a player requests to skip their current pending action.
      Parameters:
      nick - the nickname of the player requesting the skip
      Throws:
      InvalidPhaseException - if the game is not in the correct phase
      InvalidPlayerException - if the player making the skip is not the current player
      InvalidSkipException - if the current action cannot be skipped
